text_block_list.text:
After running in the Kobe Shimbun Hai,
Silence
Suzuka appears lighter and
refreshed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Bolstered by a newfound sense of
unwavering
determination, Silence
Suzuka sets her sights on
the autumn
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She still needs more experience in order
to reach
her lofty goals, so we decide to
enter her into the
Kinko Sho next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
